description: Run an adversarial review panel on a plan, a diff, or a commit range, and decide what to do with what comes back. A thin, opinionated front end to marshal-adversarial-review: how to invoke it, how to route lenses across models, which fields mean a lens is missing rather than satisfied, and why a unanimous panel is still not a decision. Use before a risky integrate, before opening a PR on a repo you do not own, or on a plan you are about to commit to. Trigger on "run a panel", "adversarial review", "review this before I open the PR", "second opinion on this diff".
